solver_notes: Native deterministic aarch64 C11 regression model of CPython subinterpreter daemon-thread deallocation. Legacy lane models an unlocked raw tstate acquisition followed by interpreter deletion before PyEval_SaveThread; poison detection proves deletion won without executing an intentional undefined-behaviour read. Fixed lane acquires head_mutex before list/tstate access, takes an atomic acquire reference, unlinks and drops the owner reference under head_mutex, then completes the daemon GIL release with acquire/release atomic decrement. Owner decrement observes refs=2, final refs=0, 1000/1000 stress iterations pass with no UAF. Scope: standalone native reproduction/fix model for the stated Python/pylifecycle.c invariant, not a claimed patch to upstream CPython or Linux. ASan allocator initialization failed in this Pi runtime; UBSan stress completed cleanly and this platform limitation is disclosed.
